purpose: run production databases on infrastructure that meets availability, performance, security and recovery needs
entry_criteria: Database engine, size and recovery objectives are decided
procedure: Choose managed or self-managed hosting from objectives, skills and cost; write the reasons down.
Provision from code with encryption at rest and in transit, private networking and least-privilege access.
Configure high availability and replicas to meet the objective and test a failover.
Configure monitoring for capacity, replication lag, connections and slow queries, with alerts.
Set up patching and maintenance windows and confirm backups restore.
Document the connection method, limits and runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Encryption and private networking are in place
Failover was tested against the objective
Monitoring and alerts cover capacity and replication

validation.command: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode   # example; exit 0 after apply

validation.check: trigger a failover in a non-production copy and time it

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A managed PostgreSQL cluster with one replica in another zone is provisioned from code, reachable only from the application subnet, with alerts for replication lag; a failover test completes in 40 seconds.
